result.title: ADClaw: A Programmable Visual Agent for Industrial Anomaly Detection and Understanding
result.summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD), the task of identifying and localizing deviations from normal product conditions, is essential to automated quality inspection in manufacturing. Many vision-language models for IAD rely on large domain-specific datasets for fine-tuning and make predictions in a single pass, leaving no opportunity to re-examine ambiguous regions. Although tool-using agents can revisit these regions, predefined tool interfaces limit how they can combine intermediate results in a follow-up check. When such checks are insufficient, models may miss subtle defects or misidentify the defect type. To address this limitation, we introduce ADClaw, an inspection agent that uses executable code to test anomaly hypotheses without task-specific fine-tuning. For each hypothesis, a Structured Normality Prior identifies the applicable rules and retrieves normal visual references for the inspection target. Guided by this prior, the agent writes and executes code in a persistent Inspection Workbench to combine masks, anomaly maps, and measurements from earlier steps into a new test of the suspected defect. After each check, Hypothesis-Guided Evidence Reasoning assesses whether the evidence supports the suspected defect and its location, using gaps or inconsistencies in that evidence to guide the next code action. ADClaw achieves competitive results in detection and localization across 2D and 3D industrial anomaly detection benchmarks and in anomaly understanding on MMAD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ADClaw：一个不做任务特定微调的工业异常检测 agent。它先用结构化正常性先验确定适用规则并检索正常参考，再在持久「检查工作台」中编写并执行代码，把此前的掩码、异常图与测量组合成对缺陷假设的新检验，并根据证据中的缺口或不一致决定下一步动作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「假设—取证—据证据缺口决定下一步」的循环，可能为 LVR 的证据获取、重检模糊区域与停止决策提供对照视角，也可核查外置代码状态与 latent 状态在信息保真上的差异；但状态以代码工件而非 latent 表示承载，且属工业检测应用，联系较远。
